ns2:course.label: Stereotypes, Prejudice & Discrimination
ns2:course.description: Grand Challenge Learning course in Inequality & Cultural Understanding provides an interdisciplinary introduction to questions related to societal inequality. Each section emphasizes experiential learning through, for example, field trips or hands-on, community-based research projects. Same as PSYC 144.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Social & Beh Sci - Beh Sci, Grand Challenge-Inequality, and Cultural Studies - US Minority course.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: This course is intended for first and second year students.
